intent: Teach refill purpose, bakery-before-bus order, cafe size/view and both accent spellings, nearby-grown food, relative Saturday bank closure, signed-form office instructions, rainwater yard-cleaning purpose and warehouse reuse.

三条新信息
面包店在首班车之后开门。银行星期日关门较晚。工厂用雨水擦窗户。
词语提示：after 之后；Sundays 星期日；later 较晚；windows 窗户。
